title: Computational Reflective Equilibrium for Agentic AI: A Rawlsian Alignment Scaffold for Governance
reasoning: The paper focuses heavily on the ethical alignment of AI systems, proposing a computational framework (Agentic Reflective Equilibrium) based on John Rawls's moral philosophy. It explicitly models and evaluates how LLM agents perform ethical and moral reasoning to resolve conflicting values (e.g., honesty, loyalty, privacy, and fairness) during case studies.
